function modifier_item_autocast_controller:ModifyHero(raw_kv_withlevel, parent)

        if ps then

            else

                parent:CastAbilityNoTarget(ps, parent:GetPlayerID())

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 ~= "none" then

            if string.find(behavior, "AUTOCAST", 1, true) then

                    ps:ToggleAutoCast()
                end
            elseif string.find(behavior, "NO_TARGET", 1, true) then
                parent:CastAbilityNoTarget(ps, parent:GetPlayerID())
            end
        end
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP ~= "none" then

            if self.mod then

            end
        end
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.Skill and raw_kv_withlevel.Skill ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.Skill ~= "none" then
        self.skill = raw_kv_withlevel.Skill

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent and tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent) > 0 then

        end

            self.skill_level = raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel
        end

            dummy_index = self.dummy:GetEntityIndex(),

        bIsAttack  = false,
        ExtraData  = {
            owner_entindex = self.owner:entindex(),
            dummy_entindex = self.parent:entindex(),
            base_damage    = profile.base_damage,
            hit_label      = profile.hit_label,
            proj_speed     = proj_speed,

            spawn_time     = GameRules:GetGameTime(),
            max_time       = 2,
        }
    }

    local proj_id = ProjectileManager:CreateTrackingProjectile(info)
    info.ExtraData.projectile_id = proj_id
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:InitProjectileProfile(params)
    if not params then return end
    local name = params.name
    if not name or name == "" or name == "none" then return end
    if not params.interval or params.interval <= 0 then return end

    local is_attack = (name == "attack" or name == "ranged_attack")
    local profile = {
        projectile_name = name,
        interval = params.interval,
        range = params.range or 0,
        base_damage = params.base_damage or 0,
        pure_percent = params.pure_percent or 0,
        lifesteal = params.lifesteal or 0,
        hit_label = hit_label,
        is_attack = is_attack,
        attack_mode = (name == "ranged_attack" and "ranged" or "melee"),
        dummy_mode = (not is_attack and params.dummy_mode) or nil,
        next_cast_time = 0,
    }

    if not profile.is_attack then
        profile.skill = self.parent:AddAbility(name)
        if profile.skill then
            profile.skill:SetLevel(1)
            if params.level and params.level > 1 then
                profile.skill:SetLevel(params.level)
            end
            profile.skill:SetActivated(true)
            profile.skill_kv = profile.skill:GetAbilityKeyValues()
            profile.behavior = ResolveCastBehavior(profile.skill_kv)
        end
    else
        profile.behavior = "Target"
    end

    table.insert(self.projectiles, profile)

    DebugPrint(self, "profile",
        "name", tostring(params.name),
        "interval", tostring(params.interval),
        "range", tostring(params.range),
        "level", tostring(params.level or 1),
        "behavior", tostring(profile.behavior),
        "attack", tostring(profile.is_attack))
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval)
    if not enemy or enemy:IsNull() then return end
    if not self.owner or self.owner:IsNull() then return end
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then return end

    local dummy_name = self.parent and self.parent:GetUnitName() or "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy"
    local clone = CreateUnitByName(
        dummy_name,
        pos,
        false,
        self.owner,
        self.owner,
        self.owner:GetTeamNumber()
    )

    if not clone then return end

    clone:SetOwner(self.owner)
    clone:SetControllableByPlayer(self.owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
    local lvl = self.parent and self.parent:GetLevel() or 1
    if lvl > 1 then
        clone:CreatureLevelUp(lvl - 1)
    end

    clone:AddNewModifier(clone, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
    clone:AddNewModifier(clone, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
    clone:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)

    clone:AddNewModifier(self.owner, self.ability, "modifier_dummy_autocast", {
        projectile_name             = "none",
        projectile_interval         = 0,
        projectile_range            = 0,
        projectile_base_damage      = 0,
        heal_percent                = self.heal_percent,
        pure_percent                = self.pure_percent,
        projectile_dummy_mode       = "none",

        projectile_sp               = self.projectile_sp,
        projectile_sp_interval      = self.projectile_sp_interval,
        projectile_sp_range         = self.projectile_sp_range,
        projectile_sp_base_damage   = self.projectile_sp_base_damage,
        projectile_sp_purePercent   = self.projectile_sp_purePercent,

        projectile_sp_2             = self.projectile_sp_2,
        projectile_sp_2_interval    = self.projectile_sp_2_interval,
        projectile_sp_2_range       = self.projectile_sp_2_range,
        projectile_sp_2_base_damage = self.projectile_sp_2_base_damage,
        projectile_sp_2_purePercent = self.projectile_sp_2_purePercent,

        passive_name                = self.passive_name,
        passive_level               = self.passive_level,
        passive_sp                  = self.passive_sp,
        passive_sp_level            = self.passive_sp_level,
        passive_sp_2                = self.passive_sp_2,
        passive_sp_2_level          = self.passive_sp_2_level,

        ability_sp                  = self.ability_sp,
        modifier_sp                 = self.modifier_sp,
        lifesteal_sp                = self.lifesteal_sp,
    })

    local ab = clone:AddAbility(profile.projectile_name)
    if ab then
        ab:SetLevel(1)
        ab:SetActivated(true)
    end
    if not ab then
        table.insert(self.clone_dummies, clone)
        return
    end

    if profile.behavior == "NoTarget" then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
    elseif profile.behavior == "Self" then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
            TargetIndex = self.owner:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
    elseif profile.behavior == "Position" then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
            AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
            Position = pos,
            Queue = false,
        })
    elseif profile.behavior == "Target" then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
            TargetIndex = enemy:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
    end

    table.insert(self.clone_dummies, clone)

    local ttl = math.max(interval or 0, 0.2)
    Timers:CreateTimer(ttl, function()
        if clone and not clone:IsNull() then
            clone:Destroy()
        end
    end)

    DebugPrint(self, "spawn clone",
        "ability", tostring(profile.projectile_name),
        "ttl", tostring(ttl),
        "target", enemy:GetUnitName())
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:StartProjectileTimers()
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not self.projectiles or #self.projectiles == 0 then return end

    self.timer_handles = self.timer_handles or {}

    for idx, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        local offset = 0
        local id = Timers:CreateTimer(offset, function()
            return self:OnProjectileThink(profile)
        end)
        table.insert(self.timer_handles, id)
    end
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnProjectileThink(profile)
    if not IsServer() then return end

    if self.is_paused then
        return 0.1
    end

    if not profile then
        return 0.1
    end

    if (not profile.is_attack and not profile.skill) or (not self.owner) or (self.owner:IsNull()) then
        return 0.1
    end

    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    if profile.next_cast_time and profile.next_cast_time > now then
        return math.max(0.05, profile.next_cast_time - now)
    end

    if HasHigherPriorityReady(self, profile, now) then
        DebugPrint(self, "priority defer", "ability", tostring(profile.projectile_name))
        return 0.05
    end

    if IsUnitBusy(self.parent) then
        DebugPrint(self, "busy skip", "ability", tostring(profile.projectile_name))
        return 0.1
    end

    local interval = self:GetFinalInterval(profile.interval)
    DebugPrint(self, "think",
        "ability", tostring(profile.projectile_name),
        "owner_pos", VecToString(self.owner and self.owner:GetAbsOrigin()),
        "dummy_pos", VecToString(self.parent and self.parent:GetAbsOrigin()))

    if profile.dummy_mode == "clone" then
        local origin = self.parent:GetAbsOrigin()
        local range = self:GetFinalCastRange(profile.range)

        local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
            self.parent:GetTeamNumber(),
            origin,
            nil,
            range,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
            FIND_CLOSEST,
            false
        )

        if #enemies == 0 then
            DebugPrint(self, "no enemies",
                "ability", tostring(profile.projectile_name),
                "range", tostring(range),
                "origin", VecToString(origin))
            return 0.1
        end

        local enemy = enemies[1]
        local pos = enemy:GetAbsOrigin()
        DebugPrint(self, "clone cast",
            "ability", tostring(profile.projectile_name),
            "target", enemy:GetUnitName(),
            "dist", tostring((pos - origin):Length2D()))
        self:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval)
        profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
        return interval
    end

    if profile.behavior == "Self" then
        if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsCooldownReady() then
            return 0.1
        end
        if self.special_handler and self.special_handler.PrepareCast then
            self.special_handler:PrepareCast(self, profile, self.owner, self.owner and self.owner:GetAbsOrigin())
        end
        DebugPrint(self, "cast self", tostring(profile.projectile_name))
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
            TargetIndex = self.owner:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })

        profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
        return interval
    end

    local origin = self.parent:GetAbsOrigin()
    local range = self:GetFinalCastRange(profile.range)

    local enemy = nil
    local pos = nil

    if profile.behavior == "Position" or profile.behavior == "Target" or profile.behavior == "NoTarget" or profile.is_attack then
        local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
            self.parent:GetTeamNumber(),
            origin,
            nil,
            range,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
            FIND_CLOSEST,
            false
        )

        if #enemies == 0 then
            DebugPrint(self, "no enemies",
                "ability", tostring(profile.projectile_name),
                "range", tostring(range),
                "origin", VecToString(origin))
            return 0.1
        end

        enemy = enemies[1]
        pos = enemy:GetAbsOrigin()

        local dir = pos - origin
        dir.z = 0
        local minDist = range * 0.5
        local maxDist = range - 50
        local normal_dir = dir:Normalized()

        local dist = dir:Length2D()
        if dist < 150 then
            pos = origin + normal_dir * minDist
        end

        if dist > range then
            pos = origin + normal_dir * maxDist
        end
    end

    if profile.is_attack then
        self:UpdateAttackStats(range, interval)
        self.parent.__autocast_attack_profile = profile
        local use_projectile = (profile.attack_mode == "ranged")
        DebugPrint(self, "attack",
            "target", enemy and enemy:GetUnitName() or "nil",
            "range", tostring(range),
            "interval", tostring(interval),
            "dummy_pos", VecToString(self.parent and self.parent:GetAbsOrigin()),
            "target_pos", enemy and VecToString(enemy:GetAbsOrigin()) or "nil")
        self.parent:PerformAttack(
            enemy,
            true,           -- bUseCastAttackOrb
            true,           -- bProcessProcs
            true,           -- bSkipCooldown
            false,          -- bIgnoreInvis
            use_projectile, -- bUseProjectile
            false,          -- bFakeAttack
            true            -- bNeverMiss
        )
        profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
        return interval
    end

    if pos then
        self.parent:SetCursorPosition(pos)
        self.parent:FaceTowards(pos)
    end

    if profile.behavior == "Position" then
        if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsCooldownReady() then
            return 0.1
        end
        if self.special_handler and self.special_handler.PrepareCast then
            self.special_handler:PrepareCast(self, profile, enemy, pos)
        end
        DebugPrint(self, "cast position", tostring(profile.projectile_name))
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
            AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
            Position = pos,
            Queue = false,
        })
        profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
    elseif profile.behavior == "Target" then
        if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsCooldownReady() then
            return 0.1
        end
        if self.special_handler and self.special_handler.PrepareCast then
            self.special_handler:PrepareCast(self, profile, enemy, pos)
        end
        DebugPrint(self, "cast target", tostring(profile.projectile_name),
            "target", enemy and enemy:GetUnitName() or "nil")
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
            TargetIndex = enemy:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
        profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
    elseif profile.behavior == "NoTarget" then
        if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsCooldownReady() then
            return 0.1
        end
        if self.special_handler and self.special_handler.PrepareCast then
            self.special_handler:PrepareCast(self, profile, enemy, pos)
        end
        DebugPrint(self, "cast no_target", profile.skill:GetAbilityName())
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
        profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
    end

    return interval
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnAttack(params)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not IsDebugEnabled() then return end
    if not params or params.attacker ~= self.parent then return end
    DebugPrint(self, "on_attack",
        "target", params.target and params.target:GetUnitName() or "nil")
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnAttackLanded(params)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not IsDebugEnabled() then return end
    if not params or params.attacker ~= self.parent then return end
    DebugPrint(self, "on_attack_landed",
        "target", params.target and params.target:GetUnitName() or "nil")
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:AddCustomTransmitterData()
    return self.final_cache_server or {}
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:HandleCustomTransmitterData(data)
    self.final_cache = data or {}
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetProfileForAbilityName(ability_name)
    if not self.projectiles then return nil end

    if not ability_name then
        for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
            if profile.is_attack then
                return profile
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        if profile.projectile_name == ability_name then
            return profile
        end
    end

    return nil
end

## Skills
A skill is a set of local instructions to follow that is stored in a `SKILL.md` file. Below is the list of skills that can be used. Each entry includes a name, description, and file path so you can open the source for full instructions when using a specific skill.
### Available skills
- skill-creator: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Codex's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations. (file: C:/Users/ym199/.codex/skills/.system/skill-creator/SKILL.md)
- skill-installer: Install Codex skills into $CODEX_HOME/skills from a curated list or a GitHub repo path. Use when a user asks to list installable skills, install a curated skill, or install a skill from another repo (including private repos). (file: C:/Users/ym199/.codex/skills/.system/skill-installer/SKILL.md)
### How to use skills
- Discovery: The list above is the skills available in this session (name + description + file path). Skill bodies live on disk at the listed paths.
- Trigger rules: If the user names a skill (with `$SkillName` or plain text) OR the task clearly matches a skill's description shown above, you must use that skill for that turn. Multiple mentions mean use them all. Do not carry skills across turns unless re-mentioned.
- Missing/blocked: If a named skill isn't in the list or the path can't be read, say so briefly and continue with the best fallback.
- How to use a skill (progressive disclosure):
  1) After deciding to use a skill, open its `SKILL.md`. Read only enough to follow the workflow.
  2) If `SKILL.md` points to extra folders such as `references/`, load only the specific files needed for the request; don't bulk-load everything.
  3) If `scripts/` exist, prefer running or patching them instead of retyping large code blocks.
  4) If `assets/` or templates exist, reuse them instead of recreating from scratch.
- Coordination and sequencing:
  - If multiple skills apply, choose the minimal set that covers the request and state the order you'll use them.
  - Announce which skill(s) you're using and why (one short line). If you skip an obvious skill, say why.
- Context hygiene:
  - Keep context small: summarize long sections instead of pasting them; only load extra files when needed.
  - Avoid deep reference-chasing: prefer opening only files directly linked from `SKILL.md` unless you're blocked.
  - When variants exist (frameworks, providers, domains), pick only the relevant reference file(s) and note that choice.
- Safety and fallback: If a skill can't be applied cleanly (missing files, unclear instructions), state the issue, pick the next-best approach, and continue.

local function FindDummyAutocastProfile(attacker, damaging_ability)
	if not attacker or attacker:IsNull() then
		return nil, nil
	end

	local ability_name = damaging_ability and damaging_ability.GetAbilityName and damaging_ability:GetAbilityName() or nil
	local mods = attacker:FindAllModifiers()

	if mods then
		for _, mod in pairs(mods) do
			if mod and mod.GetName and mod:GetName() == "modifier_dummy_autocast" then
				if mod.GetProfileForAbilityName then
					local profile = mod:GetProfileForAbilityName(ability_name)
					if profile then
						return mod, profile
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local fallback = attacker:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
	if fallback then
		local profile = fallback.GetProfileForAbilityName and fallback:GetProfileForAbilityName(ability_name) or nil
		return fallback, profile
	end

	return nil, nil
end

function barebones:DamageFilter(keys)

	local attacker
	local victim
	if keys.entindex_attacker_const and keys.entindex_victim_const then
		attacker = EntIndexToHScript(keys.entindex_attacker_const)
		victim = EntIndexToHScript(keys.entindex_victim_const)
	else
		return false
	end

	local original_attacker = attacker
	local original_victim = victim

	local inflictor = keys.entindex_inflictor_const -- nil if damage is not caused by an ability
	local damaging_ability = inflictor and EntIndexToHScript(inflictor) or nil
	local modifier_autocast, profile = FindDummyAutocastProfile(attacker, damaging_ability)

	if modifier_autocast then
		if profile then
			if profile.hit_label ~= nil then
				victim.hit_label = profile.hit_label
			end

			if profile.base_damage ~= nil then
				victim.base_damage = profile.base_damage
			end

			if profile.pure_percent ~= nil then

    id = tonumber(id)
    local cfg = self.items[id]

    local factor = cfg.price_factor or 1.0
    local count  = cfg.buy_count or 0

function modifier_item_stats:IsHidden() return true end

function modifier_item_stats:IsPurgable() return false end

function modifier_item_stats:RemoveOnDeath() return false end

function modifier_item_stats:GetAttributes()
    return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPLE
end

function modifier_item_stats:DeclareFunctions()
    return {
        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ABILITY_SPECIAL,
        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ABILITY_SPECIAL_VALUE,
    }
end

function modifier_item_stats:GetModifierOverrideAbilitySpecial(params)
    if not self.tooltips then return 0 end

    if params.ability == self:GetAbility()
        and self.tooltips[params.ability_special_value] then
        --print("[Item AbilitySpecial]", self, params.ability_special_value, self.tooltips[params.ability_special_value])
        return 1
    end

    return 0
end

function modifier_item_stats:GetModifierOverrideAbilitySpecialValue(params)
    if not self.tooltips then return 0 end

    if not IsServer() then
        --print("[modifier_item_stats] Client", params.ability_special_value)
    end

    if params.ability == self:GetAbility()
        and self.tooltips[params.ability_special_value] then
        -- print("[Item AbilitySpecialValue]", self, params.ability_special_value,
        --     self.tooltips[params.ability_special_value])
        return self.tooltips[params.ability_special_value]
    end

    return 0
end

function modifier_item_stats:OnCreated()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        self:InitStat()
    end)
end

function modifier_item_stats:InitStat()
    --print("[modifier_item_stats] Server", self)
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    local ability = self:GetAbility()
    if not ability then return end

    local pid = parent:GetPlayerOwnerID()
    if pid < 0 then return end

    local lvl = ability.custom_level or self.custom_level or 1
    self.level = lvl
    local name = ability.raw_name
    local raw_kv = ItemKV[name] or AbilityKV[name]
    local type = 1
    if raw_kv and raw_kv.Shop then
        type = tonumber(raw_kv.Shop)
    end

    local kv = {}
    if type == 1 then
        kv = Shop1ItemsKV[name] or {}
    elseif type == 2 then
        kv = Shop2ItemsKV[name] or {}
    elseif type == 3 then
        kv = Shop3ItemsKV[name] or {}
    end

    self.kv = kv

    self:CollectValues()
    self:SetHasCustomTransmitterData(true)
    self:SendBuffRefreshToClients()

    ability:SetLevel(self.level)
    self:ForceRefresh()

    local attrs = {}

    if kv.BonusAttribute then
        for k, v in pairs(kv.BonusAttribute) do
            local value_array = ParseArray(v)
            local attr_value = value_array[lvl]
            if attr_value ~= nil then
                attrs[k] = attr_value
            end
        end
    end

    if next(attrs) ~= nil then
        StatsManager:AddSource(pid, self:GetSourceId(), attrs, {
            type = "equip",
            item = name,
            level = lvl,
        })
    end
end

function modifier_item_stats:CollectValues()
    if not IsServer() then return end
    local ab = self:GetAbility()

    local kv = ab:GetAbilityKeyValues()
    local sp = kv.AbilityValues

    if not sp then return end

    self.tooltips = {}
    self.tooltips.BonusAttributeKeys = {}
    for k, v in pairs(sp) do
        if k == "Level" then
            self.tooltips[k] = self.level
        else
            local kv_value = ab:GetSpecialValueFor(k)

            local array = self.kv[k] or self.kv.BonusAttribute[k]

            if self.kv.BonusAttribute[k] then
                table.insert(self.tooltips.BonusAttributeKeys, k)
            end

            local value = 0
            if array then
                value = ParseArray(array)[self.level] or 0
            end
            self.tooltips[k] = value

            --print("[modifier_item_stats] tooltip", k, value, self.level)
        end
    end
end

function modifier_item_stats:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local parent = self:GetParent()
    local pid = parent:GetPlayerOwnerID()

    if pid >= 0 then
        StatsManager:RemoveSource(pid, self:GetSourceId())
    end
end

function modifier_item_stats:GetSourceId()
    if self:GetAbility() == nil then
        return
    end

    return "equip_" .. self:GetAbility():GetAbilityName() .. "_" .. tostring(self)
end

function modifier_item_stats:AddCustomTransmitterData()
    return {
        tooltips = self.tooltips or {}
    }
end

function modifier_item_stats:HandleCustomTransmitterData(data)
    --print("[modifier_item_stats] Client", self)
    self.tooltips = data.tooltips or {}

    --DeepPrintTable(self.tooltips)
end

payload.message:
问题不在特效资源，而是在 autocast 的施法单位/位置逻辑：`axe_berserkers_call` 实际是由“克隆 dummy”在“dummy 所在位置”施放，所以嘲讽目标是 dummy/克隆，不是英雄本体，看起来就像没有特效、没有嘲讽。

关键点（带代码定位）  
- `item_axe_counter_helix` 的 `ProjectileDummyMode` 被设置成 `clone`，导致走“克隆施法”分支。`game/dzsj/scripts/npc/npc_abilities_custom.txt:2392`  
- 在 `modifier_dummy_autocast` 里，`clone` 模式会先以 dummy 自身位置找敌人（不是英雄位置），再创建克隆并让克隆施法。`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/modifier_dummy_autocast.lua:766`、`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/modifier_dummy_autocast.lua:602`  
- dummy 的位置来自商店槽位点，并不会跟随英雄。`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/modifier_item_autocast_controller.lua:299`  
- `axe_berserkers_call` 是无目标技能，嘲讽目标会强制攻击“施法者”。由于施法者是克隆 dummy（不是英雄），所以怪物嘲讽到的是克隆；克隆很快被销毁，玩家看到的效果就像“没嘲讽”。`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/modifier_dummy_autocast.lua:596`、`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/modifier_dummy_autocast.lua:670`

直观后果  
- 若 dummy 槽位离怪物远：根本找不到敌人 → 不会触发施法 → 没特效/没嘲讽。  
- 即使找到敌人并施法：嘲讽目标是克隆 dummy，不是英雄 → 玩家感觉“没嘲讽”。

如果你要让嘲讽/特效出现在英雄身上，至少要改其中一项：  
1) 取消 `ProjectileDummyMode = "clone"`，并在施法前把 dummy 移到英雄附近/英雄位置。  
2) 让英雄本体施放 `axe_berserkers_call`（给英雄加技能并在 autocast 里对英雄下 `CAST_NO_TARGET`），而不是让 dummy/克隆施放。  
3) 保持 clone，但把 clone 生成在英雄位置且不立刻销毁（否则嘲讽马上失效）。

function modifier_simple_chase_ai:OnIntervalThink()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local unit = self.parent
    if not unit:IsAlive() then return end

    local target

    local forced_target = unit.GetForceAttackTarget and unit:GetForceAttackTarget() or nil
    if forced_target and forced_target:IsNull() then

    local distance = (target:GetAbsOrigin() - unit:GetAbsOrigin()):Length2D()
    distance = math.max(0, distance - GetBoundsRadius(unit) - GetBoundsRadius(target))

    if self.state == "idle" then
        self.state = "chase"

        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = unit:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_TARGET,
            TargetIndex = target:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
        return
    end

    if self.state == "chase" then
        if distance <= self.attack_range then
            self.state = "attack"

            --print("[AI Attack]", target:GetUnitName())

            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = unit:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_ATTACK_TARGET,
                TargetIndex = target:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        end

        return
    end

    if self.state == "attack" then
        if distance > self.attack_range + 100 then
            self.state = "chase"

            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = unit:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_TARGET,
                TargetIndex = target:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        end

        return
    end
end

function FindNearestPlayer(unit, radius)
    local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
        unit:GetTeamNumber(),
        unit:GetAbsOrigin(),
        nil,
        radius,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_MAGIC_IMMUNE_ENEMIES,
        FIND_CLOSEST,
        false
    )

    for _, hero in ipairs(enemies) do
        if not hero:HasModifier("modifier_death") then
            return hero
        end
    end

    return nil
end

function monster_system:ReadEngineBase(unit)
    local name = unit:GetUnitName()
    local base = MonsterStats:GetEngineBase(name)

    if base then
        return
    end

    local base           = {}
    base.MoveSpeed       = unit:GetBaseMoveSpeed()
    local minD           = unit:GetBaseDamageMin()
    local maxD           = unit:GetBaseDamageMax()
    base.Attack          = (minD + maxD) * 0.5
    base.AttackSpeed     = unit:GetAttackSpeed(true) * 100
    base.AttackTime      = 1 / unit:GetAttacksPerSecond(true)
    base.AttackRange     = unit:GetBaseAttackRange()
    base.Armor           = unit:GetPhysicalArmorBaseValue()
    base.MagicResistence = unit:GetBaseMagicalResistanceValue()
    base.Health          = unit:GetBaseMaxHealth()
    base.HealthRegen     = unit:GetBaseHealthRegen()
    base.Mana            = unit:GetMana()
    base.ManaRegen       = unit:GetManaRegen()

    MonsterStats:SetEngineBase(name, base)
end

function MonsterStats:ComputeFinalCacheKey(buffid_list)
    local key_parts = { "Buff" }

    table.sort(buffid_list)

    for _, buffID in ipairs(buffid_list) do
        table.insert(key_parts, "|" .. tostring(buffID))
    end

    return table.concat(key_parts, "")
end

function monster_system:StoreStat(buffs, name, tag)
    if MonsterStats:Get(tag) then
        return
    end

    MonsterStats:AddAllBuffs(buffs, tag)
    MonsterStats:UpdateDisplayFinal(tag)
    MonsterStats:UpdateDelta(name, tag)
end

function monster_system:Spawn(name, pos, buffTag)
    local unit = CreateUnitByName(name, pos, true, nil, nil, DOTA_TEAM_NEUTRALS)
    unit:SetForwardVector(BadForward)

    if not unit then
        print("monster_system:Spawn failed to create unit:", name, pos, buffTag)
        return nil
    end

    unit._monster_buff_tag = buffTag

    self:ReadEngineBase(unit)

    return unit
end

function monster_system:ApplyStat(unit)
    local mod_ai = unit:AddNewModifier(unit, nil, "modifier_simple_chase_ai", {})

    local mod = unit:AddNewModifier(unit, nil, "modifier_monster_stats", {})

    if mod then
        mod:RecalculateFinalValues()
        mod:ForceRefresh()
    end

    local tag = unit._monster_buff_tag
    local final = MonsterStats:GetFinal(tag)
    local health = final.Health or 0
    local mana = final.Mana or 0

    unit:SetBaseMaxHealth(health)
    unit:SetMaxHealth(health)
    unit:SetHealth(health)
    unit:SetMana(mana)
    unit:SetMaxMana(mana)

    --print("[Monster Stats]", unit, unit:GetMaxHealth(), "Time", GameRules:GetGameTime())

    return mod_ai
end

我这边无法查看原版 C++ 实现细节（本地仓库里也没有引擎源码），所以不能直接“解析 C++ 代码”。但从 Dota 引擎行为可推断出嘲讽的核心：  
- 施法时给敌人加 taunt modifier（比如 `modifier_axe_berserkers_call`），同时引擎会把被嘲讽单位的攻击目标强制到施法者（等价于 `SetForceAttackTarget(caster)`）。  
- 当嘲讽结束，引擎会清空该强制目标（等价于 `SetForceAttackTarget(nil)`）。

要保证 `modifier_simple_chase_ai.lua` 的变量/数据一致性，你需要确保 AI 读取的是 **ForceAttackTarget**，而不是自定义的 `target_entid`。你现在的 AI 已经优先用 `GetForceAttackTarget()`，这与原版行为是一致的。  

因此一致性校验的重点只有两点：  
1) 嘲讽是否真的让怪物拥有 `ForceAttackTarget`（如果为 nil，就说明嘲讽没走引擎逻辑或被自定义脚本覆盖）。  
2) 嘲讽期间 `target_entid` 不应覆盖 forced target（当前 AI 里 forced target 优先级更高，逻辑上没问题）。

如果你愿意，我可以加最小调试（只在 taunt 时打印 `GetForceAttackTarget()`）来验证一致性；或者给 `modifier_simple_chase_ai.lua` 增加兜底：检测到 taunt modifier 时强制使用 `GetForceAttackTarget()`。

    end
    print("[AI][DEBUG]", self.parent:GetUnitName(), self.parent:entindex(), ...)

function modifier_simple_chase_ai:OnIntervalThink()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local unit = self.parent
    if not unit:IsAlive() then return end

    local target

    local forced_target = unit.GetForceAttackTarget and unit:GetForceAttackTarget() or nil
    if forced_target and forced_target:IsNull() then

    end

    end

    if forced_target then

    elseif unit.target_entid then
        target = EntIndexToHScript(unit.target_entid)
        if not target then
            self.state = "idle"
            return
        end
    else
        self.state = "idle"
        return
    end

    if target and not target:IsAlive() then
        target = nil
    end

    if not target then
        self.state = "idle"
        return
    end

    local function GetBoundsRadius(ent)
        if not ent or ent:IsNull() then
            return 0
        end

        if ent.GetHullRadius then
            return ent:GetHullRadius()
        end

        return 0
    end

    local distance = (target:GetAbsOrigin() - unit:GetAbsOrigin()):Length2D()
    distance = math.max(0, distance - GetBoundsRadius(unit) - GetBoundsRadius(target))

    if self.state == "idle" then

        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = unit:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_TARGET,
            TargetIndex = target:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
        return
    end

    if self.state == "chase" then
        if distance <= self.attack_range then
            self.state = "attack"

            --print("[AI Attack]", target:GetUnitName())

            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = unit:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_ATTACK_TARGET,
                TargetIndex = target:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        end

        return
    end

    if self.state == "attack" then
        if distance > self.attack_range + 100 then
            self.state = "chase"

            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = unit:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_TARGET,
                TargetIndex = target:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        end

        return
    end
end

function FindNearestPlayer(unit, radius)
    local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
        unit:GetTeamNumber(),
        unit:GetAbsOrigin(),
        nil,
        radius,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_MAGIC_IMMUNE_ENEMIES,
        FIND_CLOSEST,
        false
    )

    for _, hero in ipairs(enemies) do
        if not hero:HasModifier("modifier_death") then
            return hero
        end
    end

    return nil
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:InitProjectileProfile(params)
    if not params then return end
    local name = params.name
    if not name or name == "" or name == "none" then return end
    if not params.interval or params.interval <= 0 then return end

    local is_attack = (name == "attack" or name == "ranged_attack")
    local profile = {
        projectile_name = name,
        interval = params.interval,
        range = params.range or 0,
        base_damage = params.base_damage or 0,
        pure_percent = params.pure_percent or 0,
        lifesteal = params.lifesteal or 0,
        hit_label = hit_label,
        is_attack = is_attack,
        attack_mode = (name == "ranged_attack" and "ranged" or "melee"),
        dummy_mode = (not is_attack and params.dummy_mode) or nil,
        next_cast_time = 0,
    }

    if not profile.is_attack then
        profile.skill = self.parent:AddAbility(name)
        if profile.skill then
            profile.skill:SetLevel(1)
            if params.level and params.level > 1 then
                profile.skill:SetLevel(params.level)
            end
            profile.skill:SetActivated(true)
            profile.skill_kv = profile.skill:GetAbilityKeyValues()
            profile.behavior = ResolveCastBehavior(profile.skill_kv)
        end
    else
        profile.behavior = "Target"
    end

    table.insert(self.projectiles, profile)

    DebugPrint(self, "profile",
        "name", tostring(params.name),
        "interval", tostring(params.interval),
        "range", tostring(params.range),
        "level", tostring(params.level or 1),
        "behavior", tostring(profile.behavior),
        "attack", tostring(profile.is_attack))
end

原因在 `modifier_item_autocast_controller.lua` 的这段逻辑：只有当 `ProjectileSP2` **不是** `"none"` 时才会设置 `self.projectile_sp_2_interval`。  
所以即便 KV 里有 `ProjectileSP2Interval`，只要 `ProjectileSP2` 是 `"none"`，`self.projectile_sp_2_interval` 就保持 `nil`。

对应位置：`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/modifier_item_autocast_controller.lua`（`if raw_kv_withlevel.ProjectileSP2 ...` 这段）

另外一种可能是 `ProjectileSP2Interval` 是类似 `"0 0 0 0 12 8"` 的多段字符串，`tonumber` 会返回 `nil`。这种要用 `ParseArray(...)[level]` 取。

要不要我把这段改成：  
- 即使 `ProjectileSP2 == "none"` 也解析并打印 interval  
- 或统一对 `ProjectileInterval / ProjectileSPInterval / ProjectileSP2Interval` 用 `ParseArray` 按等级取值？
